followup_reviews.Research finding: Retain the Wazen/Wazzen–Dehiba interruption because the mayor reports completed restoration after a closure. Passenger and goods passage and the Tunisian approach-road protests remain the documented scope. The initial restricting actor and any exemptions are not independently established. Retain unknown onset and restoration no later than 12 August 2018. The reported three-day length is not subtracted from publication to fabricate dates or numerical duration; first restoration day remains unknown. Retain Uncoded. Protest occurrence and a secured road do not identify demands or establish a trade, socioeconomic or security rationale for the initial restriction. One LANA report attributes the operational account to mayor Mohamed Sanam. Its government-news-agency host does not convert the mayor’s statement into independently observed reopening. Retain unlocated Wazen/Wazzen–Dehiba crossing and approach text with null coordinates. The narrative does not identify a defensible barrier coordinate or national border extent.
